run_merge_clusters: run the merge_clusters script to merge wav2vec features by cluster labels using mean or sample pooling
run_merge_with_mean_pooling: run merge_clusters with mean pooling to average features within consecutive cluster segments
run_merge_with_sample_pooling: run merge_clusters with sample pooling to randomly sample one feature per cluster segment
review_merge_function: review the merge function that pools features by unique consecutive cluster IDs using torch
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that defines CLI args for source, split, save-dir, cluster-dir, and pooling
